description: This file declares the IOmiProxy interface, which provides methods for managing crypted bundles and registering/unregistering error listeners, typically used in a component related to OMI (Open Management Infrastructure) interactions.

classes.name: omi::IOmiProxy
classes.description: An abstract interface for interacting with OMI proxies, including methods to mount/unmount crypted bundles and manage error listeners.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given container identifiers and configuration paths, outputting the decrypted config path.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle identified by its container ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback, returning a listener handle.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered error listener.

ctags.name: OmiErrorListener
ctags.pattern: /^    typedef std::function<void(const std::string&, ErrorType, const void*)> OmiErrorListener;$/
